name: Shimogō (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Shimogō town emblem in white: a ring open at the hoist crossed by two horizontal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Shimogō, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 29 April 1980.

features.role: Shimogō town emblem — a ring open at the hoist crossed by two horizontal bars
